description: This file contains test mocks for account-related functions, using 'vitest' to mock the './accounts.js' module. It sets up mock implementations for functions like list, resolve, and check account statuses.

methods.name: listZalouserAccountIds
methods.description: Returns a mock list containing 'default' account ID

methods.name: resolveDefaultZalouserAccountId
methods.description: Returns the string 'default' as the resolved default account ID

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccountSync
methods.description: Returns a mock account object created by createDefaultResolvedZalouserAccount

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccount
methods.description: Asynchronously returns a mock account object from createDefaultResolvedZalouserAccount

methods.name: listEnabledZalouserAccounts
methods.description: Asynchronously returns an array with a single mock account object

methods.name: getZcaUserInfo
methods.description: Asynchronously returns null, indicating no user info

methods.name: checkZcaAuthenticated
methods.description: Asynchronously returns false, indicating user is not authenticated
